title: Testing & Verification
description: Review of unit and integration tests, hardware-in-the-loop and system testing, robustness and long-run testing, and test reporting.

items.text: Unit tests run off target in CI on every change
items.hint: E.g. Unity, CppUTest or GoogleTest on the host, with the hardware layer mocked.

items.text: Code coverage is measured, and untested critical modules are known
items.hint: Coverage is a guide, not a target. Look at what isn't covered.

items.text: Logic that decides safety or outputs has thorough tests, including boundaries
items.hint: State machines, control logic, schedulers, parsers.

items.text: Structural coverage meets what the safety standard requires
items.hint: Statement, branch or MC/DC coverage depending on class or SIL.

items.text: Automated tests run on real hardware for each release candidate
items.hint: A HIL rig, or at least scripted bench tests with a pass or fail result.

items.text: Every requirement has a test, and results are recorded against the build that was tested
items.hint: Use the Requirements tab: link each requirement to its check and record the evidence.

items.text: Tests run on the current hardware revision, and differences from earlier boards are known
items.hint: A test pass on EVT boards may not hold on DVT boards.

items.text: Manual test procedures are written so anyone can repeat them
Interoperability is tested with real phones, apps, routers and backends
items.hint: Keep a matrix of tested versions.

items.text: Soak tests run for days under realistic load without resets or memory growth
items.hint: Track heap, stack, queues and the reset count over the run.

items.text: Fault injection covers sensor failure, comms loss, storage failure and power loss
items.hint: Each specified fault behavior should have a test that forces it.

items.text: The firmware is tested during EMC and ESD testing, with its behavior recorded
items.hint: Note any reset, lockup or corrupt display, and which recover on their own.

items.text: Behavior is tested at temperature extremes
items.hint: Oscillator startup, flash writes and sensor accuracy change with temperature.

items.text: Clock and timer wrap-around are tested by starting timers near rollover
